confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on mixed aggregator and blog figures, so they are moderate at best. Mid-range meal-for-two figures in the sources range from about $18 to $25, and I set $30 for three courses. Cocktail and wine_glass are set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 3x beer, wine glass about 2.5x beer) because direct Tainan data was weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no live listings checked. FX: the RBA observation below is the most recent I could confirm from search-result text (I did not open the RBA page itself), and I could not confirm it is the latest published as of 2026-11-19. TWD amounts were converted at about 32 NT$ per US$, inferred from conversions in the sources, not from an RBA figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors use an East Asia basis: Taiwan city averages and venue listings from aggregator sites and travel guides (mainly Taipei and Taichung), adjusted down for Tainan's lower cost level. Accommodation anchors come from general knowledge of Taiwanese budget and business hotel and hostel rates.
